gap: No result ChatGPT got states the cost per Wh and Wh per lb for every Group 24 Bluetooth candidate at today's price. The only one I could work out from an opened page is the LiTime Group 24 Smart Bluetooth: 58.5 Wh/lb and $0.243/Wh at a September price.
standout_why: I compared against our own page (dealectric.com, read 2026-11-14), which gives no runtime, Wh/lb or $/Wh, and against Nautworthy's LiTime page (rank 12 in one chat, not cited), which already gives $243/kWh and 3.3 h at a 30 A load for the LiTime. ChatGPT's own answers already say about 2 h at 50 A and 2.5 h at 40 A. The cited maker pages (Vatrer, Redodo, Power Queen, WattCycle) and solargenadvisor would not load for me (403, 429 or a TLS error), so I could not check whether they hold these figures. What I could derive is partly in rival results already, and it covers only one or two products.
decides: It doesn't decide the pick yet. All candidates are rated near 1,280 Wh, so runtime at a given motor draw is the same for all of them, and only $/Wh and Wh/lb can separate them. On the inputs I have, the Vatrer at $259.99 (our 2026-11-03 price) works out to $0.203/Wh against $0.243/Wh for the LiTime at its September price. That supports keeping the Vatrer as the pick, but only if today's prices and net weights are read from the maker pages, which I couldn't do.
